summary: CIRP approval challenge; valuation report sharing under Regulation 35; Form G publication compliance; commercial wisdom of CoC not justiciable; eligibility under Trusts Act s.88 and Companies Act s.164(2)(b); related party creditor treatment; promotion of settlement offer under s.12A; CoC voting thresholds; subsequent events including unanimous 100% voting share approval of settlement; NCLAT reversal of NCLT approval; remand to CoC for fresh EOI process.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; NCLAT judgment modified to consider subsequent event of unanimous CoC approval of settlement; remand to NCLT for consideration of s.12A proposal approved with 100% voting share; fresh CIRP process initiated after impugned judgment stayed subject to final orders.
